objectives.text: The statutory authority of the Secretary of Agriculture for making and insuring loans to farmers and ranchers should be revised and consolidated to provide for more effective credit services to farmers.

citations.quote: The Congress finds that the statutory authority of the Secretary of Agriculture, hereinafter referred to in this chapter as the "Secretary," for making and insuring loans to farmers and ranchers should be revised and consolidated to provide for more effective credit services to farmers.

obligations.action: promulgate such regulations as may be necessary to carry out this title and the amendments made by this title

citations.quote: no later than 180 days after the date of the enactment of this Act [Nov. 28, 1990], the Secretary shall promulgate such regulations as may be necessary to carry out this title and the amendments made by this title.

obligations.actor: this title [enacted by Pub. L. 101-624, Rural Economic Development Act of 1990]
obligations.action: be construed to adversely affect the eligibility, as it existed on the date of enactment of this Act, of cooperatives and other entities for any other credit assistance under Federal law

citations.quote: Notwithstanding any other provision of law, this title [see Short Title of 1990 Amendment note set out above] shall not be construed to adversely affect the eligibility, as it existed on the date of enactment of this Act [Nov. 28, 1990], of cooperatives and other entities for any other credit assistance under Federal law.

obligations.action: ensure that only adequately prepared officers/employees are assigned to an area and that a high priority is placed on keeping existing farm operations operating (sense of Congress)
obligations.trigger: in carrying out the provisions of the Consolidated Farm and Rural Development Act

citations.quote: It is the sense of Congress that, in carrying out the provisions of the Consolidated Farm and Rural Development Act [see Short Title note set out above], the Secretary of Agriculture should ensure that-

"(1) only officers and employees of the Department of Agriculture who are adequately prepared to understand the particular needs and problems of farmers in an area are assigned to such area; and 

 "(2) a high priority is placed on keeping existing farm operations operating."

obligations.actor: reference to any superseded provisions of the Bankhead-Jones Farm Tenant Act or the Act of August 28, 1937
obligations.action: be construed as referring to the appropriate provision of this title
obligations.trigger: provisions superseded by any provision of this title

citations.quote: Reference to any provisions of the Bankhead-Jones Farm Tenant Act [see section 1000 of this title ] or the Act of August 28, 1937 ( 50 Stat. 869 ), as amended, superseded by any provision of this title [this chapter] shall be construed as referring to the appropriate provision of this title [this chapter].

obligations.actor: the repeal of any provision of law by this title
obligations.action: affect the validity of any action taken or obligation entered into pursuant to authority of said Acts, or prejudice the application of any person for assistance solely because such person is obligated to the Secretary under a repealed provision

citations.quote:
The repeal of any provision of law by this title [this chapter] shall not- 

 "(1) affect the validity of any action taken or obligation entered into pursuant to the authority of any of said Acts, or 

 "(2) prejudice the application of any person with respect to receiving assistance under the provisions of this title [this chapter], solely because such person is obligated to the Secretary under authorization contained in any such repealed provision.

notes: This section (7 U.S.C. 1921) is solely a congressional findings/purpose provision; its only operative statement is the hortatory 'should' finding that the Secretary's lending authority be revised and consolidated. All other extractable obligations/definitions/interactions derive from the accompanying editorial and statutory notes (Effective Date, Regulations, Preservation of Eligibility, Use of Qualified Personnel, savings/separability §341) rather than the operative text of §1921 itself. Text bears the header 'Text contains those laws in effect on July 22, 2026.' The 'Use of Qualified Personnel' provision is expressly a 'sense of Congress' rather than a binding duty, though it uses 'should.' Terms like 'making and insuring loans,' 'credit services,' and 'socially disadvantaged farmers and ranchers' are used but not defined within this source and are recorded as '(undefined here)'.
